name: number-functions
source:
Print Abs($80000000)
Print Abs(-3)/2
Print Abs(-3.5)/2
Print Int(3)/2
Print Int(3.5)/2
Print Int(-3.5)
Print Int(4294967296.0)
Print Sgn(3.5)/2

encoding.notes: Literal opcode and line bytes: Abs=0x06aa, Sgn=0x06a0, Int=0x06b4, Print=0x0476, divide=0xffec; independent of the production token table and encoder. Function offsets follow original C_Tk records.

evidence.notes: FnAbs performs NEG.L without an overflow guard. FnInt is integer identity; FnIntF dispatches SPFloor through Float_Fonction, retaining float type. FnSgnF returns Ret_Int after SPTst. The manual specifies floor for negative fractional input. Expectations are derived from source and documented mathffp contracts, not captured AMOS execution. Library-version edge behavior remains provisional.
